title: Corners
body:
1/8th the volume of a normal block for more detailed builds. There is a corner for every vanilla block that has a slab. - Use a multipart blockstate system - Can be placed in any configuration but can't be mixed with different corner blocks - Can be waterlogged - Internal face culling - Support rotation/mirroring when generated as part of a structure - Copper corners can oxidise and be waxed - Wooden corners burn and can be used as fuel (5 corners smelt 1 item) - Uses vanilla textures, most resource packs are supported

The license is CC0. Use [the code](https://github.com/stohun01/Corners-Fabric-1.21.X/blob/master/src/main/java/net/stohun/corners/block/CornerBlock.java) however you wish in your own projects.
